attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording of the Earnings Call for the Q2 FY27
voiceSummary: Regaal Resources Limited has disclosed the audio recording of the earnings conference call held on November 16, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. The call discussed the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://regaalresources.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Audio-Recording-of-Earnings-Call-for-the-Q2-FY27.mp3. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 46 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requests the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd and BSE Limited to take this information on record.

attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jay Synth Organics Limited filed newspaper clippings regarding the publication of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, standalone total income from operations was 13,313.46 lakhs, with a net profit after tax of 478.32 lakhs. Consolidated total income from operations stood at 13,452.52 lakhs, with a consolidated net profit after tax of 1,033.72 lakhs. The company also incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Vama Tax Limited, on July 17, 2026.

attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release in relation to the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Regaal Resources Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors took on record these results on November 13, 2026. For the second quarter of Financial Year 2026-27, the company reported a Profit After Tax of 232 million rupees, representing a 38.7% year-on-year increase. The PAT margin stood at 7.3%. Operating income was recorded at 3,166 million rupees, while Operating EBITDA reached 542 million rupees with a margin of 17.1%. For the first half of Financial Year 2026-27, Profit After Tax was 365 million rupees, showing a 41.6% year-on-year growth. Operating income for the half year was 5,187 million rupees, and Operating EBITDA was 852 million rupees. The company noted a 20.2% increase in maize crushing volumes to 1,60,179 metric tons for the half year. Exports increased by 64.5% year-on-year to 366.7 million rupees for the half year.

attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Regaal Resources Limited filed an investor presentation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The filing relates to the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website at https://regaalresources.com/investor-presentation/. The document details Q2 FY27 performance metrics including operating income of 3,166 million, core manufacturing revenue of 3,127 million, and profit after tax of 232 million. It also outlines the company's strategic initiatives, capacity expansion to 1,650 TPD, and operational updates. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Tinku Kumar Gupta on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Regaal Resources Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Regaal Resources Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3,165.62 Million. Profit before tax for the quarter was Rs. 310.81 Million. Profit for the period was Rs. 231.84 Million. Earnings per share was Rs. 2.25. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was Rs. 5,187.11 Million. Profit before tax was Rs. 489.44 Million. Profit for the period was Rs. 365.12 Million. Earnings per share was Rs. 3.55. The company issued 2,70,400 equity shares under its employee stock option plan. An exceptional item of Rs. 6.43 Million was recorded due to SGST reimbursement issues. Statutory auditors M/s Singhi & Co issued a limited review report.
